## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (new behaviour has tests; bug fixes have a regression test)
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass locally
- [ ] README / docs updated in this PR if behaviour or configuration changed
- [ ] No secrets, real hostnames or IPs (use example.com / 192.168.1.100)
- [ ] API responses do not expose new internal details (env vars, tokens, labels not meant for the UI)
- [ ] Conventional commit messages
